learning_outcomes.text: Students acquire the ability to name the fundamentals of thermodynamics and apply them to problems in various areas of mechanical engineering, especially in energy technology.
As an elemental part of the module, students can explain and apply the main laws of thermodynamics.
Students are able to describe and compare the energy conversion processes important in mechanical engineering.
Based on simplifications also applied in practice, students can analyze these processes and assess their efficiency.

Students are able to discuss thermodynamic relationships of mixtures of ideal gases, real gases, and humid air, explain them based on molecular properties, and analyze changes of state of these relationships using the main laws of thermodynamics.
Furthermore, students possess the ability to analyze chemical reactions in the context of thermodynamics and to explain and apply the mechanisms of heat transfer.

syllabus_topics: 1st Law for resting and moving systems
Behavior of real substances described by tables, diagrams, and equations of state
Mixtures of ideal and real substances
Review of the material from "Thermodynamics and Heat Transfer I"
Behavior of real substances described by equations of state
Chemical reactions and application of the main laws to chemical reactions
assessment_rules: The module grade is weighted by ECTS points.
